macro.title: JetBlue Leads The Industry In Raising Checked Bag Fees… Again! - One Mile at a Time
macro.summary: JetBlue has raised checked bag fees again for tickets purchased as of November 3, 2026. A first domestic bag now costs $50-70, and competitors may follow.

macro.title: Nearly $1.9 billion traded on midterms in booming prediction markets - The Washington Post
macro.summary: Prediction markets are exploding in popularity, with more trades placed on the midterms this year than in any other election cycle.

macro.title: What the midterm elections could mean for markets, debt - Fox Business
macro.summary: Democrats winning Congress could mean tougher AI oversight and market volatility, while a Republican sweep may ease concerns over tech investigations.
